concept: Choosing delayed reward over immediate gratification when it actually matters
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Musashi's mastery-through-repetition tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student faces a realistic choice between an appealing immediate option and a less appealing option that serves a real longer-term goal
exercise.branching_choice: Student picks a path and sees a believable downstream effect
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made the immediate option pull so strongly

assessment.success_marker: student names the specific pull of the immediate option, not just the abstract principle of delayed gratification
